items.title: Helsing debuts Clarity military AI to challenge Palantir in Europe

items.title: Can Palantir Technologies (PLTR) Still Match Its Price With Cash Flow?
items.summary: Palantir Technologies has delivered a very large 3 year share price gain. After a choppy few months the core question for investors is whether the current valuation can be explained by the cash the business is expected to generate. With the stock up roughly 7x over three years, a lot now rides on whether that past return lines up with the long term cash flows Palantir can produce.
